scheme_name: Leave Travel Concession Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Leave Travel Concession Scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

This scheme was introduced to provide financial assistance to workers in the organized sector in Haryana. 

The scheme aims to promote the welfare of laborers by enabling them to travel within India. 

It was officially launched on 1st April 2018. 

The primary objective of the Leave Travel Concession Scheme is to provide a subsidy for travel expenses incurred by workers and their families. 

The scheme specifically targets workers who are registered under the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

The measurable target of the scheme is to ensure that at least 10,000 workers benefit from the travel concession annually. 

The scheme provides a financial benefit of up to ₹10,000 per worker for travel expenses. 

This amount can be utilized for travel by train, bus, or other public transport. 

The assistance is provided to cover travel costs for the worker and their family members. 

Eligible beneficiaries include workers who have been registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board for a minimum of six months. 

Workers must be employed in the organized sector and must not exceed an annual income of ₹3,00,000. 

The scheme is open to both permanent and contractual workers. 

To apply for the Leave Travel Concession Scheme, workers must follow a specific application process. 

The first step is to obtain the application form from the Haryana Labour Welfare Board’s official website or local office. 

Applicants must fill out the form with accurate personal and employment details. 

The application must include supporting documents such as proof of employment. 

This can include a salary slip or an employment certificate from the employer. 

Additionally, applicants must provide a copy of their identity proof such as an Aadhar card or voter ID. 

Once the application form is completed, it should be submitted to the nearest Haryana Labour Welfare Board office. 

Applications can also be submitted online through the official portal. 

The processing time for applications is typically around 30 days from the date of submission. 

Successful applicants will receive the financial assistance directly into their bank accounts. 

The disbursement of funds is typically done on a quarterly basis. 

This means that eligible workers can expect to receive their travel concession at least four times a year. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is the primary implementing authority for this scheme. 

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana. 

For any queries or assistance, workers can contact the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at their official helpline number. 

The helpline number is 1800 180 2080. 

Workers can also visit the official website of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board for more information. 

The website provides detailed guidelines and updates regarding the scheme. 

The Leave Travel Concession Scheme is part of a broader effort by the Haryana government to enhance the welfare of laborers. 

It complements other welfare schemes aimed at improving the living standards of workers. 

The scheme has been well-received by the labor community in Haryana. 

It has significantly contributed to the mobility of workers and their families. 

This has allowed them to explore various parts of India which they may not have visited otherwise. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also encourages family bonding through travel. 

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board has reported an increase in applications since the launch of the scheme. 

In the first year alone, approximately 5,000 workers availed of the travel concession. 

This number is expected to grow as awareness about the scheme increases. 

The Leave Travel Concession Scheme is a unique initiative that highlights the importance of travel for personal and family development. 

It recognizes the hard work of laborers and provides them with an opportunity to enjoy their earnings. 

The scheme also aims to boost local tourism by encouraging workers to travel within the country. 

By facilitating travel, the scheme contributes to the overall economic growth of the region. 

The Haryana government continues to monitor the effectiveness of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The Leave Travel Concession Scheme is an example of how government initiatives can directly impact the lives of workers. 

It is designed to alleviate the financial burden associated with travel. 

The scheme reflects the commitment of the Haryana government to support its labor force. 

In conclusion, the Leave Travel Concession Scheme is a significant welfare initiative. 

It provides essential financial assistance to workers in Haryana. 

The scheme encourages travel and promotes family togetherness. 

The implementation of the scheme is managed by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 

Workers can benefit from the scheme by following the outlined application process. 

This initiative is a step towards enhancing the quality of life for laborers in the state. 

The Leave Travel Concession Scheme is a vital component of Haryana's labor welfare policies. 

It aims to empower workers by providing them with opportunities for leisure and exploration. 

The scheme is expected to evolve in the coming years to meet the needs of the workforce. 

Overall, the Leave Travel Concession Scheme serves as a model for similar initiatives across India. 

It emphasizes the importance of travel as a means of relaxation and rejuvenation for workers. 

The financial assistance provided under the scheme is a testament to the Haryana government's dedication to labor welfare. 

The scheme is a valuable resource for workers seeking to enhance their quality of life through travel. 

The Leave Travel Concession Scheme stands as a beacon of support for the labor community in Haryana.
